sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: It's great to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Well, I'm very grateful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我非常感激。

sentences.en: I've been looking forward to it.
sentences.zh: 我一直很期待。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You think I haven't?

sentences.zh: 我是认真的。

sentences.zh: 好的，我们非常感谢你抽出时间，我想从一个困难但必要的问题开始，请教一下你的姓氏该怎么发音。

sentences.en: It's Dannon Felser.
sentences.zh: 是达农·费尔瑟。

sentences.en: Dannon Felser.
sentences.zh: 达农·费尔瑟。

sentences.zh: 我叫你玛乔丽可以吗？

sentences.en: Of course, yes.
sentences.zh: 当然，可以。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Marjorie, the reason we wanted to talk to you and talk to you right now is because you lead an organization, the Susan B.
sentences.zh: 那么，玛乔丽，我们想采访你、而且是现在就采访你的原因，是因为你领导着一个组织，即苏珊·B.

sentences.en: Anthony List, that seeks to end abortion in the United States in part by electing lawmakers who oppose abortion and in part by confirming conservative justices to the
sentences.zh: 安东尼名单，该组织旨在通过选举反对堕胎的议员，以及确认保守派法官进入

sentences.en: federal bench and ultimately to the Supreme Court in order to eventually overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 联邦法院并最终进入最高法院，从而最终推翻罗诉

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案，以此在部分上结束美国的堕胎权。

sentences.en: Does that summarize the group's mission accurately?
sentences.zh: 这个总结准确概括了该组织的使命吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you got it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你抓住了重点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, I have to imagine this is quite a day to be talking to you because it is now about 1.03 in the afternoon
sentences.zh: 所以，我想象今天对你来说一定是个特殊的日子，因为现在是下午1点03分左右

sentences.en: on Tuesday, and we have just watched as several Republican senators who seem to be on the fence
sentences.zh: 星期二，我们刚刚看到几位似乎对填补金斯伯格大法官空缺席位

sentences.en: about filling Justice Ginsburg's vacant seat said that they would seek to confirm a replacement for her in the coming weeks, the latest of those being Senator Mitt Romney.
sentences.zh: 犹豫不决的共和党参议员表示，他们将在未来几周内寻求确认她的继任者，其中最新表态的是参议员米特·罗姆尼。

sentences.en: And so, it very much seems like you are on the cusp of a historic victory for social and religious conservatives and for the mission of your group.
sentences.zh: 因此，这非常像你正处于社会和宗教保守派以及你们组织使命的历史性胜利的边缘。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, no matter who you are, you feel the ground shaking underneath, wondering where the nation is going.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，无论你是谁，你都会感到大地在脚下震颤，想知道国家将走向何方。

sentences.en: For me, it is a surreal moment.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一个超现实的时刻。

sentences.en: It is actually very hard to put into words.
sentences.zh: 其实很难用言语来表达。

sentences.en: I'm feeling very optimistic for the mission that our organization launched on
sentences.zh: 我对我们组织在

sentences.en: 25 years ago.
sentences.zh: 25年前发起的使命感到非常乐观。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I wonder if in 2015, when you were first facing the prospect of a Donald Trump presidency, if you could have ever imagined that just over four years later, it would get you here
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在2015年你首次面临唐纳德·特朗普当选总统的前景时，你是否曾想象过仅仅四年多后，它会把你带到

sentences.en: to this point.
sentences.zh: 这一步。

sentences.en: Michael, I was deeply opposed to the candidacy of this president.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我曾强烈反对这位总统的竞选。

sentences.en: He was the last on a very long list and a distant last of people that I thought should be among, I mean, I think there were 17 at the high point candidates.
sentences.zh: 在我觉得应该位列其中的人选名单中，他是极其冗长名单上的最后一个，而且遥遥落后，我的意思是，候选人最多的时候好像有17个。

sentences.en: And I put out letters in South Carolina and in Iowa saying, not this guy.
sentences.zh: 我在南卡罗来纳州和艾奥瓦州都发表了公开信，说：不要选这家伙。

sentences.en: So, I did get dragged kicking and screaming to the candidacy.
sentences.zh: 所以，我确实是被迫且不情愿地接受了他的竞选。

sentences.en: And so, the answer to your question is, yeah, I would have been shocked to hear that this president would operate as the
sentences.zh: 所以，对你问题的回答是，是的，如果当时听说这位总统会作为

sentences.en: most pro-life president in history and that he would be the one to be naming a self-described pro-life
sentences.zh: 历史上最坚定的反堕胎总统运作，并且他会成为那个提名自称反堕胎的

sentences.en: Supreme Court Justice 3 that could turn the tide of events on abortion law after four decades since
sentences.zh: 最高法院大法官、从而在自罗诉韦德案以来的四十年后扭转堕胎法律局势的人，我会感到震惊。

sentences.en: Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 罗诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk a little bit more about that journey that you and your organization went on, the kicking and screaming.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们多谈谈你和你的组织所经历的那段不情愿的历程。

sentences.en: I realize this is asking a lot of someone who now has a close relationship with the president.
sentences.zh: 我意识到对一个现在与总统关系密切的人提出这一点要求有点多。

sentences.en: But if you could go back to your worst views and fears of him at the time and describe for me what you were thinking about him and what he represented to you in that
sentences.zh: 但如果你能回到你当时对他的最糟糕看法和恐惧，向我描述你在

sentences.en: early period of 2015, 2016.
sentences.zh: 2015、2016年初的那段早期时间里，对他是怎么想的以及他代表了什么。

sentences.en: I don't mind talking about it because I actually, as a convert on this cause, I can say that it's very much reflective of what people probably used to think of me when I was
sentences.zh: 我不介意谈论这个，因为事实上，作为这一事业的皈依者，我可以坦言，这非常反映了当年我还是一个

sentences.en: very strongly pro-choice.
sentences.zh: 坚定的支持堕胎权的人时，别人大概对我的看法。

sentences.en: You know, my view changed pretty diametrically to the position I had.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的观点发生了相当截然相反的变化。

sentences.en: But I, whatever people felt about me at that point is exactly how I felt about this president.
sentences.zh: 但是，不管当时人们对我是怎么想的，我当时对这位总统就是怎么想的。

sentences.en: We can't possibly have somebody who just converted overnight be the candidate.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能让一个一夜之间改变立场的人成为候选人。

sentences.en: And I didn't like the caustic comments to Carly Fiorina, who I adored at the time.
sentences.zh: 而且我不喜欢他对卡莉·费奥莉娜的尖刻评论，我当时非常崇拜她。

sentences.en: So, what I saw, I wasn't pleased with.
sentences.zh: 所以，我所看到的，并没有让我满意。

sentences.en: And it's the point I would say that in my entire life, I've never been so happy to be so incredibly wrong about the commitments that he would make and how he would actually govern.
sentences.zh: 而且我要说的是，我这辈子从来没有因为自己错得如此离谱、错判了他将做出的承诺以及他实际的执政方式而感到如此高兴。

sentences.en: And when you say conversion, you mean his conversion from someone who supported abortion rights, supported candidates who supported
sentences.zh: 当你提到“皈依”时，你是说他从一个支持堕胎权、支持支持

sentences.en: abortion rights, to someone who was opposed to abortion, who was pro-life.
sentences.zh: 堕胎权的候选人的人，转变成了一个反对堕胎、支持生命权的人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, before we get to those commitments, I want to slow down just a little bit and talk about the journey that you went on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在我们谈到那些承诺之前，我想稍微放慢节奏，聊聊你所经历的心路历程。

sentences.en: And not linger too much on it, but I do think it's important to understand.
sentences.zh: 虽然不用过多纠结，但我确实认为这很重要。

sentences.en: During the period when you had objections to him, you did not mince words.
sentences.zh: 在你反对他的那段时间里，你直言不讳，没有丝毫掩饰。

sentences.en: And I just want to put a pin in how strongly you doubted him during that period.
sentences.zh: 我只是想强调一下你当时对他的怀疑有多深。

sentences.en: Because you mentioned letters that you had issued against his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 因为你提到了你针对他的竞选活动发表过的公开信。

sentences.en: And there is a very pointed letter that I recall you addressed to Republican voters as the Iowa caucuses were about to get underway.
sentences.zh: 我记得在艾奥瓦州党团会议即将拉开帷幕时，你曾向共和党选民发表了一封非常尖锐的信。

sentences.en: And I was in Iowa during that time.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在艾奥瓦州。

sentences.en: So I remember this.
sentences.zh: 所以我还记得这件事。

sentences.en: And this is what you said.
sentences.zh: 你是这么说的：

sentences.en: Quote, as pro-life women leaders from Iowa and across the nation, we urge Republican caucus goers and voters
sentences.zh: 引述如下：作为来自艾奥瓦州和全国各地的反堕胎女性领袖，我们敦促共和党党团会议参与者和选民

sentences.en: to support anyone but Donald Trump on the issue of defending unborn children and protecting women from the violence of abortion.
sentences.zh: 在捍卫未出生儿童和保护女性免受堕胎暴力侵害这一问题上，支持除唐纳德·特朗普以外的任何人。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump cannot be trusted.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生是不可信的。

sentences.en: And there is thankfully an abundance of alternative candidates with proven records of pro-life leadership whom pro-life voters can support.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，有大量具有经证明的反堕胎领导力记录的替代候选人，反堕胎选民可以支持他们。

sentences.en: And you went on to say, as women, we are disgusted by Mr. Trump's treatment of individuals, women in particular.
sentences.zh: 你接着说，作为女性，我们对特朗普先生对待个人、特别是对待女性的方式感到厌恶。

sentences.en: So how were you able to get from there to the decision that you needed to build a relationship with the president and start talking about commitments and partnerships?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是如何从那种立场转变成决定与总统建立关系、并开始谈论承诺和伙伴关系的呢？

sentences.en: Well, that's a double-edged question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个包含两面性的问题。

sentences.en: One is, how could you form a relationship after saying that from his perspective, right?
sentences.zh: 一方面是，从他的角度来看，在说了那样的话之后，你怎么还能建立关系？

sentences.en: That's one thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一回事。

sentences.en: And the other, how from my end, right?
sentences.zh: 另一方面是，从我这一端来看，又该如何处理？

sentences.en: So to me, there was no choice.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，别无选择。

sentences.en: It was a choice between someone who wanted to preserve abortion and expand it and have people pay for it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个二选一：一边是一个想要保留堕胎权、扩大堕胎权并让人们为此买单的人。

sentences.en: That was Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 那是希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: And he who made commitments to only pro-life judges and other things.
sentences.zh: 而另一边是他，他承诺只任命反堕胎法官以及做出其他承诺。

sentences.en: So what do you do when you're given that choice?
sentences.zh: 所以当你面临这种选择时，你能怎么做？

sentences.en: As imperfect as the choices looked, there was a better choice.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些选择看起来并不完美，但还有一个更好的选择。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, you're saying the journey was essentially
sentences.zh: 所以为了明确起见，你是说这一心路历程本质上是

sentences.en: Donald Trump's victory in the primaries.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在初选中的胜利。

sentences.en: That once he started to win, you didn't feel you had a choice between his views on abortion and Hillary Clinton's views on abortion.
sentences.zh: 一旦他开始获胜，你就会觉得在他在堕胎问题上的观点和希拉里·克林顿的观点之间，你已经没有选择。

sentences.en: You had to make a compromise.
sentences.zh: 你必须妥协。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: That's what the world of politics is.
sentences.zh: 这就是政治世界。

sentences.en: But I would not have done it if he had not made those commitments.
sentences.zh: 但如果他没有做出那些承诺，我是不会这么做的。

sentences.en: I mean, we had to have something to take door to door to over a million homes in battleground states to say, this is who this is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们必须手里拿着点东西，挨家挨户走到摇摆州的数百万个家庭去说，这就是这样一个人。

sentences.en: So yes, it was the primary and it was those commitments.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，是初选，也是那些承诺。

sentences.en: And then as we were moving into the general, he got stronger on the issue, not weaker.
sentences.zh: 然后当我们进入大选阶段时，他在这个问题上变得更加坚定，而不是减弱。

sentences.en: And the general direction of candidates is the opposite.
sentences.zh: 候选人的总体走向往往恰恰相反。

sentences.en: That first, they are all about you.
sentences.zh: 他们一开始满口都是你。

sentences.en: They love you and you're the best person on the planet.
sentences.zh: 他们爱死你了，你是地球上最棒的人。

sentences.en: And then they get into the general and they start to moderate.
sentences.zh: 然后他们进入大选，开始变得温和。

sentences.en: Well, that is not how he treated the issue.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他对待这个问题可不是这样的。

sentences.en: And he instead embraced it and communicated it and made sure that there was a contrast between his policies and his opponents and Hillary Clinton's.
sentences.zh: 相反，他拥抱了这一立场，进行了沟通，并确保他的政策与对手以及希拉里·克林顿的政策之间存在对比。

sentences.en: And that's what you hope and dream for, that there's that perfect clarity and that voters know the choice that they're making.
sentences.zh: 而这正是你所希望和梦想的，那种完美的清晰度，让选民清楚他们正在做出什么样的选择。

sentences.en: And he's the first person that did it like that.
sentences.zh: 他是第一个这样做的候选人。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about the commitments that you're referring to.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈你所指的那些承诺。

sentences.en: What exactly were the commitments and how did they come to be?
sentences.zh: 具体是什么承诺，它们又是如何达成的？

sentences.en: Well, we knew what our priorities were.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道我们的优先事项是什么。

sentences.en: So we wrote them down on a, and said, these are the commitments we would like for you to make.
sentences.zh: 所以我们把它们写在纸上，并说：这些是我们希望你做出的承诺。

sentences.en: And they were pro-life Supreme Court justices.
sentences.zh: 它们包括任命反堕胎的最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: Now, I'm very aware about how that term, pro-life Supreme Court justices, goes across to quite a number of people.
sentences.zh: 现在，我很清楚“反堕胎最高法院大法官”这个词在相当多的人听来是怎么回事。

sentences.en: One, they don't even know what that means.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们甚至不知道这意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's not accurate.
sentences.zh: 这并不准确。

sentences.en: Does that mean
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着

sentences.en: Roe versus Wade?
sentences.zh: 罗诉韦德案？

sentences.en: Does that, we wanted to be very clear that it means they take a position on abortion that is in alignment with our own.
sentences.zh: 这是否……我们希望非常明确，这意味着他们采取与我们一致的堕胎立场。

sentences.en: So that was the first commitment.
sentences.zh: 所以这是第一个承诺。

sentences.en: And it was that it'd be very clear what type of Supreme Court justices you're going to have.
sentences.zh: 并且要非常明确你将拥有什么样的最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: And what else did he commit to?
sentences.zh: 他还承诺了什么？

sentences.en: Because my sense is it wasn't just justices on the court.
sentences.zh: 因为我的感觉是，这不仅仅是法院的大法官。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court piece is the most important piece, but there was also a commitment to protect the Hyde Amendment, meaning no taxpayer funding of abortion,
sentences.zh: 最高法院的部分是最重要的部分，但也有承诺保护海德修正案，这意味着不使用纳税人的资金资助堕胎，

sentences.en: to sign a 20-week paying capable bill into law.
sentences.zh: 签署一项禁止20周以上有痛觉能力胎儿的法案使其成为法律。

sentences.en: That means no abortions on the national level after five months.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在全国范围内，怀孕五个月后不得堕胎。

sentences.en: And also defunding and reallocating Planned Parenthood's funding to other qualified health centers.
sentences.zh: 还有取消对计划生育联合会的资金资助，并将其重新分配给其他合格的健康中心。

sentences.en: So pretty sweeping commitment.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一项相当全面的承诺。

sentences.en: So were you surprised when he agreed to do all of this, when you got everything you wanted from him?
sentences.zh: 那么，当他同意做所有这些事情、当你从他那里得到你想要的一切时，你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I was a little bit surprised because we didn't have any leverage.
sentences.zh: 我有点惊讶，因为我们当时没有任何筹码。

sentences.en: He was already the candidate.
sentences.zh: 他已经是候选人了。

sentences.en: Generally, candidates in that position aren't going to put their name to anything because they don't have to anymore.
sentences.zh: 通常处于那个位置的候选人是不会对任何东西签字画押的，因为他们已经不需要这么做了。

sentences.en: But he's a different kind of candidate.
sentences.zh: 但他是一个不同寻常的候选人。

sentences.en: And he had taken this position, and he wants the benefit of it.
sentences.zh: 而且他当时表了态，他也希望借此获益。

sentences.en: And all we needed was that letter, and we gave it to him.
sentences.zh: 而我们需要的只是一封信，我们也交给他了。

sentences.en: And then the rest is history.
sentences.zh: 剩下的就都是历史了。

sentences.en: Our battleground state activity was incredibly helpful, and he knows it in the wind.
sentences.zh: 我们在关键摇摆州的活动起到了难以置信的作用，他对此心知肚明。

sentences.en: Then it made everything worthwhile because every single thing he promised and beyond, he did.
sentences.zh: 这就让一切都变得值得了，因为他许下的每一个承诺，甚至是超额的承诺，他都做到了。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk a little bit about what you mean when you said it made everything worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们来聊聊你所说的“让一切变得值得”是什么意思。

sentences.en: Because I have to say that the journey that you went on was a very long journey in a relatively short period of time.
sentences.zh: 因为我不得不说，你所经历的这段旅程，在相对较短的时间内是非常漫长的。

sentences.en: So do you think that Donald Trump actually believed in what he was signing up for?
sentences.zh: 所以你认为唐纳德·特朗普真的相信他所支持的理念吗？

sentences.en: Or in your mind, did it not really matter whether he fundamentally in his heart believed it because
sentences.zh: 或者在你看来，他内心深处是否真的相信并不重要，因为

sentences.en: he was effectively signing up to be the vehicle through which you could try to achieve what you had always been working towards?
sentences.zh: 他实际上是把自己当成了一个载体，好让你们借此去实现你们一直为之奋斗的目标？

sentences.en: In other words, did it not really matter if he maybe didn't believe what he was signing on to?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他也许并不真正相信他所签署的东西，这难道真的不重要吗？

sentences.en: It just mattered that he would do the things he signed up to do?
sentences.zh: 重要的只是他会去做他承诺要做的事吗？

sentences.en: And did it really matter if some of his actions were at odds with your faith in his personal life, especially?
sentences.zh: 如果他的某些行为与你对他的信任相悖，特别是在他的个人生活中，这真的重要吗？

sentences.en: I think what really mattered is that he take these positions.
sentences.zh: 我认为真正重要的是他采取这些立场。

sentences.en: And yes, the constant question was, does he really think this?
sentences.zh: 是的，当时不断有人问：他是真心这么想的吗？

sentences.en: Voters care if he really believes it.
sentences.zh: 选民们很在意他是否是真心相信。

sentences.en: And I think it's the unanswerable question, what's deep in the chambers of your heart?
sentences.zh: 而我认为这是一个无法回答的问题，谁知道你内心深处是怎么想的呢？

sentences.en: You know, what are your intentions?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你的意图是什么？

sentences.en: What do you—you know, it's very difficult to know.
sentences.zh: 你的——你知道的，这很难知道。

sentences.en: I know what he—
sentences.zh: 我知道他的——

sentences.en: Do you care?
sentences.zh: 你在乎吗？

sentences.en: Do you care?
sentences.zh: 你在乎吗？

sentences.en: He—if you'll notice, on this issue, people say, well, he's always scripted on it.
sentences.zh: 他——如果你注意的话，在这个问题上，人们会说，哦，他在这上面总是按稿宣科。

sentences.en: Well, he's scripted because he doesn't want to get it wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他照稿念是因为他不想弄错。

sentences.en: It's too important.
sentences.zh: 这太重要了。

sentences.en: This is one thing that I know.
sentences.zh: 这是我所知道的一件事。

sentences.en: He knows how important it is.
sentences.zh: 他知道这有多重要。

sentences.en: And it is important to him because he's done everything and beyond that he ever promised to do.
sentences.zh: 这对他也确实很重要，因为他已经完成了他曾承诺过的一切，甚至做得更多。

sentences.en: I mean, what you're describing is—and tell me if you think this is uncharitable or, you know, too practical.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你所描述的是——如果这听起来很不厚道，或者说过于现实，请告诉我。

sentences.en: But you're describing a very transactional understanding with a presidential candidate in this stage.
sentences.zh: 但你描述的是在这个阶段与总统候选人的一种非常功利、交易式的理解。

sentences.en: Well, if it were only that, that would be fine.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果仅仅是那样，那倒也还好。

sentences.en: But I don't think it is only that.
sentences.zh: 但我认为不只是那样。

sentences.en: So that's how I look at it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的看法。

sentences.en: You know, it does matter what's in the human heart.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，人类的心思固然重要。

sentences.en: It also matters what the human does.
sentences.zh: 但人类的所作所为同样重要。

sentences.en: So his actions and our gambling with the idea that he was going to follow through on were far better than the gamble that we had with Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的行动以及我们赌他会兑现承诺，这两点都远比我们押注希拉里·克林顿要好得多。

sentences.en: There was no transaction possible with her.
sentences.zh: 跟她根本没有进行交易的可能。

sentences.en: There was only one possible with him.
sentences.zh: 跟他才有可能进行交易。

sentences.en: And he grew into the commitment.
sentences.zh: 而且他逐渐融入了这个承诺。

sentences.en: But to the listener of Faith, who's hearing this conversation and is thinking,
sentences.zh: 但对于听到这段对话、笃信信仰的听众来说，他们会想，

sentences.en: but how can you watch something like the Access Hollywood video, which came out at the end of the campaign, so after he had made this commitment to you, how could you watch that
sentences.zh: 你怎么能看着像《好莱坞内幕》视频那样的东西——那是竞选接近尾声时曝光的，也就是在他对你做出这个承诺之后——你怎么能看着那个，

sentences.en: and support him regardless of what you end up getting out of it?
sentences.zh: 然后无论最终能从中得到什么都依然支持他呢？

sentences.en: I'm sure you've been asked this question before, but how do you answer it?
sentences.zh: 我确信以前有人问过你这个问题，但你是怎么回答的呢？

sentences.en: Because here you're talking about someone boasting about sexually assaulting women and soon after women came forward and said, that's what he did to me.
sentences.zh: 因为在这里，你谈论的是一个吹嘘性侵女性的人，不久之后就有女性站出来说，那就是他对她做的事。

sentences.en: So I'm just, how did you think about that?
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想知道，你是怎么看待这件事的？

sentences.en: Well, I thought about it in a couple ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是从几个方面来思考的。

sentences.en: One, it was painful.
sentences.zh: 第一，这很痛苦。

sentences.en: And we're still left with the same choice.
sentences.zh: 我们面临的选择其实依然没有变。

sentences.en: Pain and two choices.
sentences.zh: 痛苦与两个选择。

sentences.en: There is a prudential choice that you have to make.
sentences.zh: 你必须做出一个明智审慎的选择。

sentences.en: And we knew what
sentences.zh: 我们很清楚

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton was going to do.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿会做什么。

sentences.en: And we knew the commitment that the president had.
sentences.zh: 我们也清楚这位总统的承诺是什么。

sentences.en: And so we had to make that choice.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须做出那个选择。

sentences.en: And we did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: And once we're in, we're all in.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们加入了，我们就全力以赴。

sentences.en: You know, I will never apologize for those actions or those comments, but I will, till the day I die, advance the policies that he committed to.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我永远不会为那些行为或那些言论辩解，但我至死都会推进他承诺过的政策。

sentences.en: And just around the corner, we're seeing the fruits of having done that.
sentences.zh: 就在不远处，我们正在看到这样做的成果。

sentences.en: You use the word prudential, and that caught me a little bit because you're not using a word that conveys morality or faith.
sentences.zh: 你用了“审慎”这个词，这有点吸引了我的注意，因为你没有使用传达道德或信仰的词。

sentences.en: You're saying prudent, if I'm hearing that word correctly.
sentences.zh: 如果我没听错的话，你说的是明智、审慎。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think actually religious people use that term quite a lot because it acknowledges a hierarchy of goods and evils involved in any decision, that decisions of great consequence all
sentences.zh: 我认为实际上宗教人士经常使用这个词，因为它承认任何决定都涉及善恶的层级，重大后果的决定

sentences.en: often involved a blend of goods and bads.
sentences.zh: 往往包含着善与恶的交织。

sentences.en: And your job is to figure out where the highest good is found, which choice leads to the highest good.
sentences.zh: 你的工作就是找出至高之善在哪里，哪种选择能通往至高之善。

sentences.en: And that's the choice we had to make in that moment.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在那个时刻必须做出的选择。

sentences.en: And in your mind, the highest good was a candidate who would fulfill your mission on the future of abortion in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在你看来，至高之善就是一个能够实现你们在美国堕胎问题上未来使命的候选人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没“错。

sentences.en: When the president does go on to win the office, I wonder how much it felt like support from groups like yours mattered.
sentences.zh: 当总统最终赢得大选时，我想知道来自你们这样的群体的支持到底有多大分量。

sentences.en: My sense is that it was pretty meaningful.
sentences.zh: 我的直觉是这相当有意义。

sentences.en: I've spoken to a couple of my colleagues here at The Times who we really trust on this subject, and they said that the president
sentences.zh: 我跟《纽约时报》的几位同事谈过，我们在这个问题上非常信任他们，他们说这位总统

sentences.en: likely would not have won several key states like Michigan, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, without
sentences.zh: 如果没有基督教保守派和你们这样的群体的支持，

sentences.en: support from Christian conservatives and groups like yours.
sentences.zh: 可能根本赢不了密歇根、威斯康星、宾夕法尼亚等几个关键州。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that he knows that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想他心里很清楚。

sentences.en: In fact, he called me right after the election to say that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，大选刚一结束他就打电话给我说了这一点。

sentences.en: And I, you know, take a little bit of exception.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我得稍微澄清一下。

sentences.en: Sometimes the pro-life people that are part of his election are sometimes Catholic, sometimes evangelical, and sometimes neither.
sentences.zh: 支持他竞选的反堕胎人士有时是天主教徒，有时是福音派基督徒，有时两者都不是。

sentences.en: Sometimes
sentences.zh: 有时是

sentences.en: Democrats, sometimes Republicans, sometimes independents.
sentences.zh: 民主党人，有时是共和党人，有时是独立人士。

sentences.en: It's one of those issues, especially in the Rust Belt states that you just mentioned, that transcends a lot of boundaries.
sentences.zh: 这是一个超越了许多界限的问题，尤其是在你刚才提到的铁锈带各州。

sentences.en: And so I think he gets that.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他懂这一点。

sentences.en: I know he gets that.
sentences.zh: 我知道他懂。

sentences.en: And once in office, in part with your support, right away, President Trump gets a chance to put a justice on the court to kind of do what it is you care so much about.
sentences.zh: 一上台，部分在你们的支持下，特朗普总统立刻就有机会往最高法院安插一名法官，来实现你们如此关心的事。

sentences.en: And he puts forward and gets confirmed a conservative jurist, Neil Gorsuch, who your group supported.
sentences.zh: 他推选并确认了一位你们组织支持的保守派法官尼尔·戈萨奇。

sentences.en: He gets a second vacancy.
sentences.zh: 他又有了第二个空缺名额。

sentences.en: He fills that with another conservative jurist, Brett Kavanaugh, who you again supported.
sentences.zh: 他用另一位保守派法官布雷特·卡瓦诺填补了空缺，你们再次给予了支持。

sentences.en: So were you surprised by how quickly this promise was kept by President Trump?
sentences.zh: 那么，特朗普总统兑现这个承诺的速度之快，有没有让你感到意外？

sentences.en: And did it start to feel that in very short order, your work was more or less kind of done?
sentences.zh: 这是否开始让你觉得，在极短的时间内，你们的工作差不多算是完成了？

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: I think we've had so many disappointments over time, where you seem like we're so close, you know, it looks just within reach.
sentences.zh: 我认为随着时间推移，我们经历过太多失望，有时候你觉得离成功那么近，你知道的，仿佛触手可及。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, something happens and it's not.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，发生了某些事，结果又不是那么回事了。

sentences.en: So the only way I know how to handle this is within the grace of daily obligation, doing the thing that has to be done today,
sentences.zh: 所以我应对这种情况的唯一方法，就是在每日职责的恩典中，做好今天必须要做的事，

sentences.en: that is the best possible strategic and smart choice that you can make.
sentences.zh: 做出你能做出的最佳战略和明智选择。

sentences.en: And so therefore, even right now, I don't take anything for granted.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使在现在，我也不会把任何事视为理所当然。

sentences.en: So yes, I'm very hopeful, very optimistic, but not wild-eyed.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我充满希望，非常乐观，但并不盲目狂热。

sentences.en: Well, I want to talk about where we are right now and what you have been fighting for over these past few days since Justice Ginsburg's passing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想谈谈我们现在的处境，以及自金斯伯格大法官去世这几天来你一直在为什么而战。

sentences.en: Another seat, the third seat opening on the court during this presidency.
sentences.zh: 又一个席位，在本届总统任期内最高法院出现的第三个空缺席位。

sentences.en: And the question for most people was, would a nomination to replace her happen before the election?
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，问题在于，接替她的提名会在大选前发生吗？

sentences.en: Would it happen after the election, given the tactics and actions of the
sentences.zh: 考虑到2016年参议院

sentences.en: Republican leadership in the Senate in 2016, or not until there was a new president or the re-election of President Trump?
sentences.zh: 共和党领导层的战术和行动，它会发生在大选之后，还是直到新总统上台或特朗普总统连任？

sentences.en: But I sense that for you, there was only one option, right?
sentences.zh: 但我感觉对你来说，只有一个选择，对吧？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You don't play roulette with that when the stakes are this high, in my opinion, and that's how we're acting.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，当赌注这么高时，你不能去玩轮盘赌，我们就是这样行动的。

sentences.en: So I think getting, to be honest, to get wrapped up in what other presidents and senates have done and other times historically, it's not nearly as important as the result.
sentences.zh: 所以老实说，我认为纠结于其他总统和参议院在历史上其他时期做过什么，远不如结果重要。

sentences.en: They were elected to do a job and they should be doing it now.
sentences.zh: 他们选出来就是为了干活的，现在就应该干。

sentences.en: So you're saying that's all beside the point to you, like when people talk about the precedent
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，当人们谈论梅里克·加兰的先例

sentences.en: of Merrick Garland or the promises that Lindsey Graham made very explicitly to the public.
sentences.zh: 或是林赛·格雷厄姆曾经向公众明确做出的承诺时，这些都无关紧要？

sentences.en: I'm not trying to be, I'm not trying to be cavalier about this, but it sounds like your approach is sort of like, who cares?
sentences.zh: 我不是想表现得轻率，但我听起来你们的方法有点像是：谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: That's process.
sentences.zh: 那是程序问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that nobody cares about process, but I also think that if you have a shot, you do it now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为没人会在乎程序，但我也认为如果你有机会，现在就得做。

sentences.en: You don't wait.
sentences.zh: 不能等。

sentences.en: And so just to be clear, what did you make clear that you wanted to have happen when Justice Ginsburg died,
sentences.zh: 为了明确起见，在金斯伯格大法官去世时，你明确希望发生的事情是什么，

sentences.en: that the president put forward a nominee and that the Senate hold a hearing before November 3rd?
sentences.zh: 是总统提出提名人选，并且参议院在11月3日之前举行听证会吗？

sentences.en: I just want to understand what was conveyed to you.
sentences.zh: 我只是想弄清楚你们传达了什么诉求。

sentences.en: Yeah, that is what we are asking and hoping, what I talked to the president about, what I talked to the vice president about, what we're talking to
sentences.zh: 是的，这正是我们所要求的和希望的，这也是我跟总统谈过的，我跟副总统谈过的，我们正在跟

sentences.en: different senators, that yes, that it be from the list, which is not in question, and that it be quickly done.
sentences.zh: 不同的参议员们谈论的，是的，人选要从那份名单中出，这是毋庸置疑的，而且要快点完成。

sentences.en: And that's what all of our conversations have been.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的对话都是围绕这个展开的。

sentences.en: And why exactly do you want it to be done so quickly and even before the election?
sentences.zh: 为什么你确切地希望这件事办得这么快，甚至在大选之前？

sentences.en: Why not wait until post-November, even if Donald Trump loses?
sentences.zh: 为什么不等到11月之后，即使唐纳德·特朗普输了？

sentences.en: Why can't he nominate the candidate?
sentences.zh: 为什么他不能提名候选人？

sentences.en: Or why can't the Senate hold hearings on the candidate between November and January?
sentences.zh: 或者为什么参议院不能在11月到1月之间就候选人举行听证会？

sentences.en: Why does it have to happen so quickly?
sentences.zh: 为什么非要这么快进行？

sentences.en: Well, a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几个原因。

sentences.en: One is that you wait and you lose all the discipline.
sentences.zh: 一个是如果你等下去，就会失去所有的纪律约束。

sentences.en: All the cats move in different directions.
sentences.zh: 所有人都会各奔东西。

sentences.en: They behave differently in a lame duck.
sentences.zh: 他们在跛脚鸭时期表现会不一样。

sentences.en: They just do.
sentences.zh: 他们就是这样。

sentences.en: People aren't under the gun of an election.
sentences.zh: 人们不再受到大选的逼迫。

sentences.en: You lose the pressure.
sentences.zh: 你就失去了压力。

sentences.en: You lose the leverage.
sentences.zh: 你就失去了筹码。

sentences.en: Also, I think it will benefit the president to go in as a winner, you know, and that being a compelling case at the ballot boxes.
sentences.zh: 此外，我认为以胜利者的姿态进入大选会对总统有利，你知道的，这在选票上是一个很有说服力的论据。

sentences.zh: 而且，如果亚利桑那州的选举对玛莎·麦萨利不利，他们会立即在那里安排一名民主党人就职，这就会改变参议院的席位对比。

sentences.en: So it's a very concrete and practical reason to go ahead and do it now.
sentences.zh: 所以现在就推进此事有着非常具体和实际的原因。

sentences.en: You referred to roulette earlier.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了轮盘赌。

sentences.en: You just don't want to take any risk that might involve a changing dynamic or changing electoral math in the Senate, which you
sentences.zh: 你只是不想冒任何可能涉及动态变化或参议院选举格局改变的风险，你

sentences.zh: 认为现在这样更有利于在大选前完成此事。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You don't play roulette when the consequences are that high.

sentences.zh: 你认为过去几天里发生的最重要的事是什么，从而说服了其中一些参议员支持你们期望的路线？

sentences.en: Because there were, on paper, significant obstacles, including these public statements that had been
sentences.zh: 因为在纸面上，存在着重大的障碍，包括这些公开声明

sentences.en: made, these commitments that had been made by several of these senators, whether it was Chuck
sentences.zh: 以及几位参议员曾经做出的承诺，无论是查克·格拉斯利，

sentences.en: Grassley, whether it was Lindsey Graham.
sentences.zh: 还是林赛·格雷厄姆。

sentences.en: I think the weight of that decision and the consequence of delay is an argument in itself.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一决定的分量和拖延的后果本身就是一个强有力的论据。

sentences.en: It has to be made by several people.
sentences.zh: 这需要多方共同努力来促成。

sentences.en: It's made by the president and the vice president.
sentences.zh: 由总统和副总统来促成。

sentences.en: It's made from me and people like me directly.
sentences.zh: 由我和像我这样的人直接推动。

sentences.en: And also, look, I think about it this way, too, is Lamar Alexander, I think, said it better than anybody.
sentences.zh: 而且，看吧，我是这样想的，拉马尔·克逊，我想他比任何人都说得好。

sentences.en: And Lamar Alexander was
sentences.zh: 而拉马尔·亚历山大是

sentences.en: somebody that was very much on the, oh, no, what is he going to do list?
sentences.zh: 那种非常坚决地列在“哦，不，他到底要干什么”名单上的人。

sentences.en: And he just made the most compelling statement that I think he really believes.
sentences.zh: 而且他刚才发表了极具说服力的陈述，我认为他是发自内心地坚信这一点。

sentences.en: And I think Romney believes the same, which is this is a constitutional duty that should be done now.
sentences.zh: 我也认为罗姆尼有同感，即这是一项应该现在就完成的宪法职责。

sentences.en: And the consequences of not doing that will be felt for decades.
sentences.zh: 而不这样做的后果将在几十年里持续显现。

sentences.en: I know I keep asking you if you were surprised, but were you surprised when Mitt Romney signed on?
sentences.zh: 我知道我一直在问你是否感到惊讶，但当米特·罗姆尼加入时，你惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I think many people expected him to, as a frequent dissenter from the president, perhaps join with Senator Susan
sentences.zh: 我想许多人原本预料他作为总统政策的常客，或许会加入苏珊·柯林斯的阵营

sentences.en: Collins, Senator Lisa Murkowski in being skeptical of this timeline.
sentences.zh: 和丽莎·穆尔科斯基参议员一样，对这个时间表持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Yes, I'm completely surprised when especially senators all line up and make the same decision.
sentences.zh: 是的，当特别是参议员们齐聚一堂并做出相同的决定时，我完全感到惊讶。

sentences.en: I'm totally shocked when there is unity because Romney is a very independent person.
sentences.zh: 当出现团结一致时，我真的惊呆了，因为罗姆尼是一个非常独立的人。

sentences.en: Grassley is a very independent person.
sentences.zh: 格拉斯利也是一个非常独立的人。

sentences.en: So, yes, I am blown away with unity at a moment where it needs to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，在一个需要团结的时刻出现团结，我感到非常震撼。

sentences.en: I'm also very cognizant that it can be scattered.
sentences.zh: 我也非常清楚这种情况可能会被打散。

sentences.en: So that's why we remain very vigilant.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们保持高度警惕。

sentences.en: Do you believe, Marjorie, that you are responsible in any way for what happened, whether that's a matter of having gotten President Trump where he is with your support in the first
sentences.zh: 玛乔丽，你是否认为对于所发生的事情，你负有某种责任？无论是由于你最初的支持才把特朗普总统推到了今天这个位置，

sentences.en: place, putting him in a position for this to happen, or the work you've done in the past few days?
sentences.zh: 为这一切的发生创造了条件，还是因为你过去几天所做的工作？

sentences.en: I mean, am I right in thinking that somewhere over the past 72, 96 hours, you and folks in your organization are on the phone with these senators, with their staff?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我的理解没错吧，在过去72到96小时里的某个时候，你和你们组织里的人一直在和这些参议员及其幕僚通电话？

sentences.en: I think I, my team and our grassroots have a lot of influence.
sentences.zh: 我认为我和我的团队以及我们的基层有很大的影响力。

sentences.en: I think we can look at it and say we're very much a part of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以回过头来看，并说我们对此发挥了重要作用。

sentences.en: I would never presume to say that we're the reason because that just wouldn't be true.
sentences.zh: 我绝不敢自称我们是根本原因，因为那样并不真实。

sentences.en: It would acknowledge the efforts of other people.
sentences.zh: 那将是对其他人努力的认可。

sentences.en: But yes, I think very much we are helping drive the center of this movement to a reclamation and a restoration of the court when it comes to Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，我认为我们在推动这场运动的核心力量，即在罗诉韦德案上收复并重塑最高法院方面，发挥了巨大作用。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Marjorie, the remaining questions now seem to only be some logistics, it feels like, around the vote and who the nominee for this vacancy will be from a pretty
sentences.zh: 所以，玛乔丽，现在剩下的问题似乎只剩下一些后勤事务了，感觉上，围绕着投票以及谁将从一份相当短的候选人名单中

sentences.en: short liSt. Is there only one path forward in your mind on this issue?
sentences.zh: 成为这个空缺席位的提名人。在你看来，这个问题只有一条前行之路吗？

sentences.en: I mean, does it have to be like when to hold the vote?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是不是非得像决定何时举行投票那样？

sentences.en: When it comes to who should get this nod, does it have to be Amy Coney Barrett in your mind?
sentences.zh: 说到谁应该获得这个提名，在你看来非得是艾米·科尼·巴雷特吗？

sentences.en: No, it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 不，并非如此。

sentences.en: She's my favorite.
sentences.zh: 她是我最喜欢的。

sentences.en: She's our favorite.
sentences.zh: 她是我们最喜欢的。

sentences.en: She's the movement's favorite because the movement knows her.
sentences.zh: 她是这场运动最喜欢的，因为这场运动了解她。

sentences.en: And she's been completely vetted.
sentences.zh: 而且她已经经过了彻底的审查。

sentences.en: We know who she is, what she's about.
sentences.zh: 我们知道她是谁，她主张什么。

sentences.en: And that is a real leg up when you're trying to move this faSt. But the list I was very much a part of.
sentences.zh: 当你试图迅速推进此事时，这是一个真正的优势。但我深度参与了那份名单的制定。

sentences.en: So, I feel like I own it in some ways.
sentences.zh: 所以，在某种程度上我觉得这有我的一份功劳。

sentences.en: So, I'm very confident that no matter who he chooses, we'll continue in exactly the direction we are.
sentences.zh: 因此，我非常有信心，无论他选择谁，我们都将完全沿着既定的方向前进。

sentences.en: So, you're open to several possible judges on that list?
sentences.zh: 所以，你对那份名单上的几位可能的人选都持开放态度？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, I want to turn to public opinion on the question of abortion and the path that you seem to be setting
sentences.zh: 因此我想转向关于堕胎问题的公众舆论，以及你目前似乎为总统和参议院设定的这条道路，

sentences.en: for the president and for the Senate in this moment, which is a decision that may ultimately be at odds with where the majority of Americans are.
sentences.zh: 这个决定最终可能会与大多数美国人的立场相左。

sentences.en: And I'm mindful of something that Justice Ginsburg said about Roe v.
sentences.zh: 我注意到金斯伯格大法官对罗诉韦德案说过的一番话。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案。

sentences.en: She had a critique of it, which is that she felt that in being so decisive and
sentences.zh: 她对该案有一个批评，即她认为由于罗案过于绝对且

sentences.en: striking down so many state laws on abortion, that Roe had kind of raced ahead of where the country was.
sentences.zh: 推翻了如此之多的各州堕胎法律，导致罗案的发展某种程度上跑到了国家现实的前面。

sentences.en: And she believed that the country was moving in the direction of Roe on its own.
sentences.zh: 她相信国家本身正在朝着罗案的方向发展。

sentences.en: And that the ruling risked a backlash from Americans by doing this work from the bench.
sentences.zh: 并且她认为，通过法官席上的这种判决，该裁决有引发美国民众强烈反弹的风险。

sentences.en: And it was a controversial critique.
sentences.zh: 这是一个备受争议的批评。

sentences.en: But I'm curious if you worry about the same thing happening, but now in the other direction, because your goal is to get Roe overturned.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，你是否担心同样的事情会再次发生，只是这次是朝另一个方向，因为你的目标是推翻罗案。

sentences.en: And I ask that because the statistics on how Americans view abortion are very consistent at this moment in the country's history.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这么问，是因为美国人如何看待堕胎的统计数据在这个国家历史的这个节点上非常一致。

sentences.en: And they show that a majority of Americans support legalized abortion and do not support overturning Roe v.
sentences.zh: 它们显示，大多数美国人支持堕胎合法化，并且不支持推翻罗诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案。

sentences.en: And I could recite a bunch of polls.
sentences.zh: 我可以列举出一堆民意调查。

sentences.en: I don't think you need me to do that.
sentences.zh: 我想你不需要我这么做。

sentences.en: So is this something you worry about doing and creating a backlash towards?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否是你担心会做的事情，以及会引发反对浪潮的事情吗？

sentences.en: I'll acknowledge that the country is worried, but the country is worried largely because the contradictions in opinion.
sentences.zh: 我承认国家确实感到担忧，但国家感到担忧主要是因为民意中存在的矛盾。

sentences.en: In other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: yes, I know that poll to be true, that the majority supports Roe v.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道那个民调是真实的，即大多数人支持罗诉韦德案。

sentences.en: Wade.
sentences.zh: 韦德案。

sentences.en: But then also they support bans after the first trimester, which is completely inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 但同时他们又支持对怀孕前三个月之后进行禁令，这完全是矛盾的。

sentences.en: And what will happen when Roe is overturned or eroded to the extent that it's not as applicable will be that states will start to pass laws that reflect the laws of those states.
sentences.zh: 而当罗案被推翻或被侵蚀到不再那么适用的程度时，将会发生的情况是，各州将开始通过反映那些州法律的法律。

sentences.en: That's the immediate effect of Roe.
sentences.zh: 这就是罗案的直接影响。

sentences.en: And only laws that will pass will be the laws that can be sustained by the majorities in those states.
sentences.zh: 并且唯一能够通过的法律将是那些能够得到这些州多数民众支持的法律。

sentences.en: And I think that people will then see, okay, it wasn't this tsunami that we thought.
sentences.zh: 我认为到那时人们会看到，好吧，这并不是我们想象的那种海啸。

sentences.en: It's actually just the bearing out of democracy on an issue of deep moral conviction
sentences.zh: 这实际上只是民主在一个具有深厚道德信念的问题上的自然体现，

sentences.en: where people's opinions get to make their way into the law rather than the Supreme Court telling them.
sentences.zh: 人们的意见得以进入法律，而不是由最高法院来告诉他们该怎么做。

sentences.en: I just want to summarize what you have been saying.
sentences.zh: 我只是想总结一下你刚才所说的话。

sentences.en: You're not worried, it sounds like, about a backlash or going against the will of the people.
sentences.zh: 听起来你并不担心会遭到强烈反对或违背人民的意愿。

sentences.en: Because in your mind, if this issue returns to the state level, which is what would happen if Roe is overturned, and the people support abortion, then abortion will still be legal.
sentences.zh: 因为在你看来，如果这个问题回归到州级别——如果罗案被推翻就会发生这种情况，而如果人民支持堕胎，那么堕胎仍将是合法的。

sentences.en: And that will be the will of the people.
sentences.zh: 那将是人民的意愿。

sentences.en: Is that what you're saying?
sentences.zh: 这就是你的意思吗？

sentences.en: That is.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: The only laws that will go into effect are laws that can be sustained by majorities of the people in the states in which they live.
sentences.zh: 唯一将生效的法律是那些能够在其所生活的州内获得多数民众支持的法律。

sentences.en: Some people will say that that may be a hard thing to measure.
sentences.zh: 有些人会说，这可能是一件很难衡量的事情。

sentences.en: There are many states where
sentences.zh: 有许多州的

sentences.en: legislatures may be solidly Republican and out of sync with the views of the majority of their residents.
sentences.zh: 立法机构可能完全由共和党掌控，并且与大多数居民的观点不一致。

sentences.en: And so restrictions might emerge that would then be reducing the availability of abortion that might be out of sync.
sentences.zh: 因此可能会出现一些限制措施，从而减少堕胎的可及性，而这可能与主流观点不一致。

sentences.en: I suppose you would argue that maybe an election would determine that then a few years later.
sentences.zh: 我想你会争辩说，也许几年后的一场选举会决定这一点。

sentences.en: But is there not a real risk that very suddenly state legislatures that have been
sentences.zh: 但难道没有这样一种真正的风险吗：那些经过划分选区、被改造成以共和党为主、

sentences.en: gerrymandered, that have been made Republican in ways that don't reflect the views of the majority of
sentences.zh: 且无法反映该州多数选民观点的州立法机构，会突然出台一些限制堕胎的措施，而这些措施与你所谈论的民主原则不一致？

sentences.en: voters in that state, would suddenly restrict abortion in ways that would not be in sync with the democratic principles you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 这与你谈论的民主原则背道而驰？

sentences.en: Well, look, I think democracy is the only institution that we have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，我认为民主是我们拥有的唯一制度。

sentences.en: There isn't a better one to gauge the will of the people and have that reflected in the law.
sentences.zh: 没有比这更好的制度来衡量人民的意愿并将其体现在法律中了。

sentences.en: I don't know a better one.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有什么更好的。

sentences.en: So to get to some consensus in our nation, that stranglehold on our ability to pass laws that
sentences.zh: 因此，为了在我们国家达成某种共识，那种扼杀我们通过法律能力的枷锁——

sentences.en: reflect our deeply held convictions about the life and death of human beings has to let up.
sentences.zh: 这些法律反映了我们对人类生命与死亡的坚定信念——必须放松。

sentences.en: And if it doesn't let up, it will be exactly the way it is now, the never-ending battle that people are sick of.
sentences.zh: 如果不放松，就会和现在一模一样，成为人们厌烦的永无休止的争斗。

sentences.en: But it's only occurring because it's a matter of life and death.
sentences.zh: 但这之所以发生，仅仅因为它是一个生死攸关的问题。

sentences.en: And we're on the verge of getting to a place where we can say we're victorious.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于能够宣布取得胜利的边缘。

sentences.en: To go back to the polling for just a minute, I think you agreed that those surveys show that the majority of Americans support Roe v.
sentences.zh: 回到民意调查，我想你同意这些调查显示大多数美国人支持罗诉韦德案，

sentences.en: Wade, support access to legalized abortion.
sentences.zh: 支持获得合法堕胎的途径。

sentences.en: So I want to understand from your viewpoint how this process may play out and what the political repercussions
sentences.zh: 所以我希望从你的角度了解这个过程将如何展开，以及在某些情况下可能会产生怎样的政治反响，

sentences.en: may be, in some cases, even for allies of yours, people who you have supported and who have supported
sentences.zh: 甚至对你的盟友、那些你支持过且支持过你的人来说也是如此，

sentences.en: you.
sentences.zh: 你。

sentences.en: And I assume that's something that you've been thinking a lot about.
sentences.zh: 我猜这也是你一直在深入思考的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think the, I think what matters is what people really think.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我认为重要的是人们真正的想法。

sentences.en: We're looking at the polls and we're seeing contradictions.
sentences.zh: 我们正在查看民调，并看到了其中的矛盾之处。

sentences.en: So what do we make of that?
sentences.zh: 那我们该如何看待这一点？

sentences.en: There's only backlash if it really is going further than the consensus will allow.
sentences.zh: 只有当事情真的超出了共识所能允许的限度时，才会引起强烈反对。

sentences.en: And if it goes further than consensus will allow, the democratic process picks up again and adjusts.
sentences.zh: 如果它超出了共识所能允许的限度，民主进程就会重新介入并进行调整。

sentences.en: So I think for people who are naturally afraid and risk-averse, yeah, they won't like it that states are starting to enact laws that reflect the will of their states.
sentences.zh: 所以我想对于那些天生害怕且风险规避的人来说，是的，他们不会喜欢各州开始颁布反映其自身州意愿的法律。

sentences.en: Because they'll be afraid, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 因为他们或许会感到害怕。

sentences.en: But that doesn't hold me up.
sentences.zh: 但这并不能阻挡我。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So I wonder if you would just indulge me for a moment.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道你是否能满足我一个小小的要求。

sentences.en: And I want to ask you to imagine a future.
sentences.zh: 我想请你想象一个未来。

sentences.en: It's November 4th.
sentences.zh: 那是11月4日。

sentences.en: A handful of Republican senators perhaps have lost their seats in part because of this process.
sentences.zh: 一小部分共和党参议员可能部分因为这个过程而失去了席位。

sentences.en: And perhaps Republicans lose control of the Senate.
sentences.zh: 并且也许共和党失去了对参议院的控制权。

sentences.en: Would it have been worth it?
sentences.zh: 这一切值得吗？

sentences.en: I'm not going there because I'm in those places.
sentences.zh: 我不会去设想那种情况，因为我正身处那些选战之中。

sentences.en: I mean, we are literally in those Senate battles right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在实际上正处于那些参议院选战中。

sentences.en: We have people going door to door in all of those Senate battles.
sentences.zh: 我们在所有这些参议院选战中都有人挨家挨户地拜访。

sentences.en: I've talked to Senator
sentences.zh: 我今天刚刚跟参议员

sentences.en: Daines, for instance, today, who says this confirmation, if it's done before the election, he does not believe it'll hurt his chances.
sentences.zh: 戴恩斯交谈过，例如，他表示这次确认如果在选举前完成，他不认为会伤害他的胜算。

sentences.en: I believe that they all think that.
sentences.zh: 我相信他们所有人都是这么想的。

sentences.en: They don't think that that's going to be the case.
sentences.zh: 他们不认为情况会那样。

sentences.en: And I think they're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们完全是对的。

sentences.en: So, yes, there is a hierarchy of goals.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，目标是有优先级顺序的。

sentences.en: But because of the way this is rolling out, that's a false choice that
sentences.zh: 但由于这件事的发展方式，那是一个我

sentences.en: I'm not willing to make.
sentences.zh: 不愿意作出的虚假选择。

sentences.en: We're not just leaving things to fall where they will.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是任由事情顺其自然发展。

sentences.en: I do not think that this hurts the president's chances of winning.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这会损害总统获胜的几率。

sentences.en: And I don't think it hurts senators' chances of winning, the ones on the pro-life side.
sentences.zh: 我也不认为这会损害参议员们——那些支持生命权一方的人——获胜的几率。

sentences.en: So it sounds like you're having these conversations.
sentences.zh: 听起来你一直在进行这些对话。

sentences.en: And I know you don't want to imagine that future, but if that were to happen, if you were to wake up and find that the Senate had been lost,
sentences.zh: 我知道你不想去设想那个未来，但如果真的发生了呢，如果你一觉醒来发现参议院失守了，

sentences.en: and maybe a bunch of senators even candidly say, we got that third Trump conservative justice on the Supreme Court, but it cost us the Senate.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能有一群参议员坦言，我们虽然把特朗普的第三位保守派大法官送进了最高法院，但代价是我们失去了参议院。

sentences.en: I want to ask you to grapple with that for just a minute.
sentences.zh: 我想请你花一点时间正视这个问题。

sentences.en: Will it have been worth it?
sentences.zh: 这一切值得吗？

sentences.en: I don't think I'm making that decision.
sentences.zh: 我认为我不是在做那个决定。

sentences.en: And so I'm not willing to make that call.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不愿意做出那种判断。

sentences.en: I think that, look, changing the court for decades and saving millions and millions of lives is the most important thing that I do.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你看，改变最高法院几十年并拯救数以百万计的生命是我所做过最重要的事情。

sentences.en: And politics is the root to that.
sentences.zh: 而政治是通往这一目标的途径。

sentences.en: So in this particular case, I do not feel that it's a choice that has to be made.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种特定情况下，我不觉得这是一个必须做出的选择。

sentences.en: I think we're doing both at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们正在同时实现这两点。

sentences.en: But you see the hierarchy of goods.
sentences.zh: 但你看到了利益的优先次序。

sentences.en: The first most important thing is who sits on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 最重要的一点是谁坐在最高法院的大法官席上。

sentences.en: When you didn't want to engage the question of whether this confirmation battle might cost
sentences.zh: 当你不想参与探讨这次确认之争是否会使共和党失去对参议院的控制时，我突然想到，

sentences.en: Republicans control of the Senate, it occurred to me that you would not want to imagine that future for the president either.
sentences.zh: 你大概也不愿意为总统想象那种未来。

sentences.en: But I have to ask, what if in the end, the president loses re-election?
sentences.zh: 但我不得不问，如果最终总统连任失败了呢？

sentences.en: The autopsies and the retrospectives look back and say that it was in part because of an
sentences.zh: 事后的复盘和回顾指出，这在部分上是因为一个被彻底激活的反对阵营，因为他急于任命第三位最高法院大法官，

sentences.en: energized opposition, because he rushed to get a third justice appointed to the Supreme Court, one who openly opposed abortion, and that was at odds with where the electorate was.
sentences.zh: 一个公开反对堕胎的人，而这与选民的立场相左。

sentences.en: If you end up losing this historic ally of yours in this battle, will that be okay?
sentences.zh: 如果你在这场斗争中最终失去了这位历史性的盟友，那也没关系吗？

sentences.en: And will it have been worth it?
sentences.zh: 这一切到底值不值得呢？

sentences.en: It's not going to be okay to lose the presidency, and it's not going to be okay to lose the Senate.
sentences.zh: 失去总统宝座是不能接受的，失去参议院也是不能接受的。

sentences.en: The first priority is the Supreme Court, without question.
sentences.zh: 首要任务毫无疑问是最高法院。

sentences.en: And I'm going to work for all three.
sentences.zh: 这三者我都会去争取。

sentences.en: I'm not willing to cede any of it.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会放弃其中任何一个。

sentences.en: I'm not.
sentences.zh: 我绝不。

sentences.en: But I am saying the most important thing is the Supreme
sentences.zh: 但我想说，最重要的是最高

sentences.en: Court.
sentences.zh: 法院。

sentences.en: And I think all those people I just mentioned agree.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我刚才提到的那些人都同意这一点。

sentences.en: You're saying you think President Trump would agree that it would have been worth losing re-election to change the composition of the Supreme Court?
sentences.zh: 你是说你认为特朗普总统会同意，为了改变最高法院的组成，失去连任也是值得的？

sentences.en: No, I think he—I'm just saying the order of goods.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得他——我只是在说各项事务的轻重缓急。

sentences.en: In the order of goods, the lasting value of the Supreme Court is a legacy for the Senate and for the president.
sentences.zh: 在各项事务中，最高法院的长远价值是留给参议院和总统的政治遗产。

sentences.en: And I can't presume to speak for him or the senators, but I'm just saying I'm fighting for them all.
sentences.zh: 我不敢妄自代他或参议员们发言，但我只是说我在为他们所有人而战。

sentences.en: Like,
sentences.zh: 比如，

sentences.en: I'm not going to cede any of it.
sentences.zh: 我不会放弃任何一部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This phrase that you used when thinking about your partnership with
sentences.zh: 你用来形容你与

sentences.en: President Trump, there was a practicality to it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统合作关系的这个短语，带有某种务实色彩。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It will all have been worth it.
sentences.zh: 这一切就都值得了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I think this entire battle, all in sum, every single thing we've done for the last decade, everything we've done since 2016,
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这场彻底的斗争，总而言之，我们过去十年做的每一件事，自2016年以来做的每一件事，

sentences.en: everything we will do for this election, if we have one more Supreme Court justice that
sentences.zh: 以及我们为这次选举将要做的一切，如果我们能再迎来一位像

sentences.en: looks like Amy Barrett or one of the others, it will all have been worth it.
sentences.zh: 埃米·巴雷特或其他那样的大法官，这一切就都值得了。

sentences.en: We're at a point of a major shift in this nation, and I'm very happy to be in the place that I am.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于这个国家发生重大转变的节点，我很高兴能处于我现在的位置。

sentences.en: Well, I really appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: I appreciate yours too, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我也谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you, Marjorie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，玛乔丽。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。
